    assert reverse_delete("abcdedcba", "ab") == ("cdedc", True)

    assert reverse_delete("abc", "abc") == ("", True)

    # No characters deleted
    assert reverse_delete("abc", "xyz") == ("abc", False)

    # Single character not deleted
    assert reverse_delete("a", "b") == ("a", True)

    # Single character deleted
    assert reverse_delete("a", "a") == ("", True)

    # Empty input string
    assert reverse_delete("", "abc") == ("", True)

    # Empty deletion string (nothing removed)
    assert reverse_delete("aba", "") == ("aba", True)

    # Case sensitivity: 'A' is not removed when 'a' is in c
    assert reverse_delete("Aba", "a") == ("Ab", False)
